levels.name: Splitting Gales
levels.description: Fires 2 additional arrows per Aimed Shot, each dealing 33% of the original arrow's DMG.

levels.name: Breeze of Reminiscence
levels.description: Skyward Sonnet decreases opponents' Anemo RES and Physical RES by 12% for 10s. Opponents launched by Skyward Sonnet suffer an additional 12% Anemo RES and Physical RES decrease while airborne.

levels.name: Ode to Thousand Winds
levels.description: Increases the Level of Wind's Grand Ode by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Hurricane of Freedom
levels.description: When Venti picks up an Elemental Orb or Particle, he receives a 25% Anemo DMG Bonus for 10s.

levels.name: Concerto dal Cielo
levels.description: Increases the Level of Skyward Sonnet by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Storm of Defiance
levels.description: Targets who take DMG from Wind's Grand Ode have their Anemo RES decreased by 20%. If an Elemental Absorption occurred, then their RES towards the corresponding Element is also decreased by 20%.
